# Hunt for the Treasure Hunter: Event Rewards

![Hunt for the Treasure Hunter: Event Rewards](/uploads/24_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

**Current treasure hunter dates:**

![](https://nukaknights.com/uploads/event_0_76-banner-treasurehunter-750x300.jpg) Starting in 43 days 7 hours

##### Treasure hunters and double mutations

*Tip: Like this event to receive a notification when it starts or someone comments.*

You will receive the new rewards in all old buckets that you still have or can craft, as well as in all new buckets that you can collect.

**Tip:** If you want to buy the **empty buckets at the train stations**, buy the **medium ones**, not the decorated ones. The drop chances are not much worse but the price is significantly lower.

## Update Legendary Notes

Basically there is a chance to get 50, 25, 10 or 5 legendary bills when opening the buckets. However, since the Atlantic City update on December 5th, 2023, this chance for the handmade buckets is 0, as well as for the dusty (looted) buckets. Only the buckets (medium and decorated buckets) that you have looted from treasure hunters still have a 9-28.35% chance of getting 50, 25, 10 or 5 legendary bills. So only “Grubenhauer Kübel” and “Decorated Kübel” still have a chance of getting legendary bills.

- Handmade dusty miner's bucket: 0.227%
- Handmade Miner's Bucket: 0.909%

In addition, all but the dusty buckets have the chance to get bottle caps, contextual ammo (ammunition for the weapon you have equipped) and up to 50 legendary bills.
